description: Welcome to the Legacy Rovers! We are a newly formed team for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our mission is rooted in the powerful idea that every piece of technology left on the lunar and Martian surfaces—from the first rover tracks to retired landers—has a rich story to tell. We believe that documenting and celebrating this "extraterrestrial heritage" is crucial for inspiring future exploration and honoring the trailblazers who made it possible.
